I am currently trying to learn Japanese myself so even though I'm fully bilingual I also fully understand the journey that's mastering a new language. We come to this world to learn and grow and I genuinely love accompanying others on their language journey. I truly believe that kindness eases change, so this is my principle for teaching.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I have had the privilege of being a Spanish teacher for five years and counting. Throughout these years I had the opportunity to see which strategies work best for learning and which don’t. I use this knowledge to figure out exactly what every individual student needs to master the language. After all, no two people learn the same way; some of my students learn better by seeing and some by doing. These one-on-one classes are like a tailored suit, fitted to be exactly what you need and match your level at all times. I know how hard it is to learn a language from scratch and I’m here to help you.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Practice truly makes perfect but practice also takes time, my catchphrase is that there is no rush. I am patient and know how much time and effort it takes to learn a second language. I teach the language from scratch but always aim to get to the point where we can have conversational lessons. Talking is in my opinion the best way to master a language. I'll always be there to help you improve your pronunciation and formulate sentences thoughtfully. I also vouch to try to make the lessons as fun as possible even when we have to memorize an exorbitant amount of verbs together.
